findings.passage: “Michigan needs its own Voting Rights Act because voting is a fundamental right, not a privilege that can be taken away by political whim. We’ve seen states like Tennessee, Louisiana and Alabama advance policies that make it harder for people to make their voices heard. We have a responsibility to ensure every eligible Michigander can vote freely, fairly and without discrimination,” said state Rep. Veronica Paiz (D-Harper Woods).
findings.note: Her statement in a joint release on the Michigan Voting Rights Act bills (House Bills 5969 to 5972). It speaks of voting rights in general and does not name voter ID or proof of citizenship.
